info.name: payment-service
info.description: Rusuh Booking Tiket — Payment Service API (port 8083)

request.description:
Info pembayaran: total, metode tersedia (enabled/disabled), sisa TTL, snap token bila sudah di-charge.

Logika `enabled`:
- `remainingSeconds < estSeconds` → `enabled: false` (waktu tidak cukup untuk selesaikan metode ini)
- Bila booking sudah expired → semua disabled + `backDisabled: true`

response.name: 200 OK — HELD, metode tersedia
200 OK — HELD 90s sisa, BCA VA disabled
200 OK — Expired, semua disabled

request.description:
Mulai pembayaran via Midtrans Snap.

Logika idempotency: jika booking ini sudah punya payment PENDING, return payment yang ada (Midtrans tidak di-charge ulang).

Method validation (server-side):
- `remainingSeconds < estSeconds` → 409 METHOD_TIME_INSUFFICIENT
- Booking status != HELD → 410 BOOKING_EXPIRED

Method yang valid: `qris`, `gopay`, `bca_va`

Webhook dari Midtrans. TIDAK butuh auth — diverifikasi via `signature_key`.

Signature: `SHA512(order_id + status_code + gross_amount + MIDTRANS_SERVER_KEY)`

Idempotency: `INSERT INTO payment_callback_log ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING` — 2x callback aman.

Status yang di-handle:
- `settlement` / `capture` + `fraud_status=accept` → booking PAID
- `expire` / `cancel` / `deny` → booking EXPIRED

Gross amount validation: nominal di callback harus cocok dengan total di DB.

Generate signature untuk test:
```
echo -n 'ORDER_ID200500000.00SERVER_KEY' | sha512sum
```
